name: Price List / Rate Card
description: A formatted price list or rate card for services or products
layout_notes: One sheet per service category if multiple categories. Use branded header row colours. Include a cover/summary tab. Keep it scannable — avoid dense footnotes inline; put notes in a separate tab.

required_sections.title: Cover / Summary
required_sections.description: Company name, logo, price list title, effective date, contact info

required_sections.title: Services & Pricing
required_sections.description: Table with columns: Service Name, Description, Unit, Price, Notes
